name: Valkyrie no Souretsu 3 ~San-nin Me no Valkyrie~
original_name: ワルキューレの葬列3～三人目の戦乙女～
source:
Battle maidens clash with the "Nightmare" that would destroy human society.
A third valkyrie has joined Crescent Bunny and Vice Faafu in the good fight. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138564.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
战斗少女们与毁灭人类社会的“梦魇”发生冲突。
第三位女武神加入了新月兔和副法福的战斗。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138564.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
